optimizedContext.value:
# Get Project Summary

## Rules

- execute(input?) always returns active/draft/discarded/archived counts, ordered workspace→spec counts and workspace count. Default flags omit active, drafts, specsHealth keys.
- Input includeChanges/includeSpecsHealth default false. Count path: ChangeRepository count/countDrafts/countDiscarded, ArchiveRepository count or meta.total, ListWorkspaces then each specRepo.count; independent I/O parallel.
- includeChanges true: list active/drafts, load each change, CountTasks.execute({ change }); entries name/state/tasks { incomplete, total }, including empty arrays. Discarded/archived count only.
- includeSpecsHealth true returns project GetSpecsHealth.execute({}).
- Constructor gets repos/use cases, no direct config/fs. createGetProjectSummary(config, options?) → resolveGetProjectSummaryDeps(resolver) → canonical factory; createKernel exposes kernel.project.getProjectSummary.
- Preserve schema-driven change and canonical metadata-path spec repository bootstrap.

## Constraints

- Default path no lists/details/tasks, metadata, graph/context or artifacts.
- Enrich only enabled; never mutate config/repos/changes.
